The '''Black Widow Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] was spotted inside the nebula in [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]].
